Which markets are affected?

The updates of the requirements apply to local to local and cross border sellers in the Malaysia market.

Who is affected?

Developers with applications that use Create Product, Edit Product, and Partial Edit Product

Which version is applicable?

The updates of the requirements apply to all versions of the related APIs

What action is required?

Without these mandatory attributes sellers will not be able to create and update products. Use the Get Attributes to check what attributes are mandatory and pass attribute values via the Create Product, Edit Product, and Partial Edit Product to help sellers fill in the attribute values.
